title: Payment Plans, Installment Fees and Late Fees for Homeowners Insurance
content:
**Payment plans.** The payment plans offered on Homeowners Insurance depend on the HomeShield program. HomeShield Essential, HomeShield Standard, HomeShield Plus and HomeShield Preferred offer the annual, semi-annual, quarterly and monthly plans. HomeShield Premier and HomeShield Estate offer the annual, semi-annual and quarterly plans; no monthly plan is offered under those two programs.

**Installment fee.** The installment fee is a fee, in dollars, on each installment after the first.

**Payment methods.** Every program accepts payment by card, ACH or check.

**Late fee.** The late fee is a fee, in dollars, on an installment paid after its due date.

## Program terms

| Program | Payment plans offered | Installment fee per installment after the first (USD) | Payment methods | Late fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeShield Essential | Annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly | 6.00 | Card, ACH, check | 15.00 |
| HomeShield Standard | Annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly | 6.00 | Card, ACH, check | 15.00 |
| HomeShield Plus | Annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly | 5.00 | Card, ACH, check | 15.00 |
| HomeShield Preferred | Annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly | 5.00 | Card, ACH, check | 10.00 |
| HomeShield Premier | Annual, semi-annual, quarterly | 4.00 | Card, ACH, check | 10.00 |
| HomeShield Estate | Annual, semi-annual, quarterly | 0.00 | Card, ACH, check | 10.00 |

## Installment fees in figures

Because the installment fee falls on each installment after the first, the first installment never carries it.

**Illustration (hypothetical plan choice).** A HomeShield Standard policy on the quarterly plan has four installments in its one-year term; the second, third and fourth each carry the 6.00 dollar installment fee, so the installment fees for the term total 18.00 dollars. The same policy on the semi-annual plan has two installments, and only the second carries the fee: 6.00 dollars for the term. On the annual plan the term premium is a single installment and no installment fee arises.

Under HomeShield Estate the installment fee is 0.00 dollars, so no plan carries an installment fee in that program.

## Late fee figures

| Program | Late fee on an installment paid after its due date (USD) |
|---|---|
| HomeShield Essential, Standard and Plus | 15.00 |
| HomeShield Preferred, Premier and Estate | 10.00 |
